description: This file defines a class C128CObject for rendering Code 128-C barcodes in PHP using the GD graphics library. It includes methods for initializing barcode parameters, calculating barcode size, and drawing the barcode including start, stop, and check characters.

classes.name: C128CObject
classes.description: A class for creating and rendering Code 128-C barcodes using PHP and GD library, extending BarcodeObject.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes barcode parameters, sets value, character sets, and barcode patterns.

methods.name: GetCharIndex
methods.description: Private method to find index of a character pattern in the charset.

methods.name: GetBarSize
methods.description: Private method to get size of a barcode bar based on resolution and character pattern.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Calculates total size (width) of the barcode based on input value and resolution.

methods.name: GetCheckCharValue
methods.description: Calculates the check character pattern for barcode validation.

methods.name: DrawStart
methods.description: Draws the start code pattern of the barcode.

methods.name: DrawStop
methods.description: Draws the stop code pattern of the barcode.

methods.name: DrawObject
methods.description: Main method to draw the full barcode, including bars, text, and control patterns.
